response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, p.product_color AS color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY color ORDER BY average_quantity IS NULL, average_quantity DESC) AS color_rank FROM grouped) SELECT order_item_id, color, average_quantity, average_cost_ratio, color_rank FROM ranked WHERE color_rank <= 3
